reconstruction.heightBasis: Current principal map heights guide this visualization: prayer body 13 m, lower/upper podiums 15/18 m, drum 18–23 m, neck 23.5–25 m, main dome 25–31 m and finial top 32.5 m; four minaret tips 60 m. Lower roofs and courtyard domes use their selected map height ranges. Three minaret balconies at about 34/39/44 m and collar near 50 m follow the mapped ring levels. The gate top 9.5 m and its cap top 13 m are mapped. Arch depths, repeated bays, dome curves, roof slopes, small turrets/finials, screens, finishes and exact structural profiles are picture estimates. Fine carving/calligraphy, lights, flags, furniture and unseen interiors are omitted; map heights are not surveyed measurements.
reconstruction.scope: Individual medium-fi Akhmad Kadyrov Mosque with mapped prayer hall and open courtyard: four triple-balcony minarets, stepped central grey domes, pale stone arched facades, lower side porches, courtyard arcades and a domed through gate. Raw principal plan/height controls retained; repeated tiny map ornaments consolidated into original shared-material details. Seven merged roles, six existing 256² graphs, four budgeted browser LODs. Fine art, furnishings, park context and unseen interiors omitted.
